title: Barcelona & Brendan - perfect match
text:
Absolute must tour, especially if you’ve got a 48 hour stop off in Barcelona and want to see the sites, get off the beaten track and see Barcelona from a unique and refreshing perspective.  

Brendan’s knowledge was perfect for us.  We like culture and history, but we liked his humour and the delivery as much as the content.  Some fantastic quirky facts you wouldn’t get from a book.  Brendan is well travelled speaks multiple languages and his story is as interesting as Barcelona itself.

He made us feel so welcome in the city he has adopted as home and the places we visited were ‘real’ Barcelo
author: Emma74UK

title: Great fun, informative & yummy!
text: You won’t be disappointed with this fun interactive and informative tour.  Learn more of local foods, where foods are sourced and served.  And yummy!!!
author: Escape796116

title: A great way to feel like a local and taste amazing food and wine.
text: Our few days in Barcelona were made even better  by an inside tour with Brendan. The tourist market is easy to find and it is lovely, but the local food markets and back street cafe’s Brendan took us to stood out. Each stop included a bit of history, great surroundings populated by locals and fantastic local Spanish food. The people behind the carefully curated stops were interesting to meet and provided a true taste of Barcelona. We thoroughly enjoyed the stories, the food  and personalized tour away from the main tourist sites. Those market garbanzo beans made with love, the olives, cheese,
author: GailPaulaH

title: Gastro-Magic in Barcelona
text:
The Barcelona Market Magic tour was the highlight of my visit to the city.
Brendan is a knowledgeable and insightful guide who really knows how to bring to life some of the hidden gems of Catalan gastronomy, easily weaving city history, with cultural and culinary background, into his commentary.
The highlight of the tour for me was the stunning finale at Pinotxos in the Sant Antoni market where the food was truly top notch.
This tour really is one not to be missed.
author: chrisd2332024

title: A culinary tour to remember, delightful blend of exquisite places and enchanting stories!
text: This culinary tour was a delightful odyssey that transcended the ordinary. The combination of exceptional places, delectable flavors, and the passionate and kind guidance of our tour leader made it an experience that will keep in my memory for a long time. I absolutely recommend this tour to anyone seeking a culinary adventure that goes beyond the plate. Such a memorable experience!
